correctness.rationale: The theorem for every integer m>=1 and two sequences is proved from 5F_r^3=F_(3r)-3(-1)^r F_r and L_r^3=L_(3r)+3(-1)^rL_r, endpoint pairing at half-length, and reversible fourth-order T_a(t),U_a(t) normalized recurrences. Directly evaluated four initial terms imply gcd_t T_a(t)=gcd(a+6,30) and gcd_t U_a(t)=gcd(3a+6,11a+12), whose Bezout combination divides 30. Parities and Lucas norm identities isolate p=2,3,5; hence for odd m both Fibonacci and Lucas 2m-window gcd equal L_m/2^[3|m], while for even m they are 3^[4|m]F_m/2^[3|m] (Fibonacci) and five times that (Lucas). Independently recomputed both sequence families for m<=60 using 15 shifts each, including length6 gcd=2 for each. The all-m result is algebraic, not obtained by extrapolating that finite range.
